original: 2. Sāmaññaphalasuttaṃ
content: 長部2經/沙門果經(戒蘊品[第一])(莊春江譯)[DA.27, AA.43.7]

original: Rājāmaccakathā
content: 國王大臣的談論

original: 150. Evaṃ me sutaṃ– ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati jīvakassa komārabhaccassa ambavane mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhateḷasehi bhikkhusatehi.
content: [[evaṃ me sutaṃ#被我這麼聽聞]]：[[ekaṃ samayaṃ#有一次]]，[[bhagavā#世尊]]與一千二百五十位[[bhikkhu#比丘]]的大比丘[[saṅgha#僧團]]一起住在王舍城養子耆婆的芒果園中。

original: Tena kho pana samayena rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto tadahuposathe pannarase komudiyā cātumāsiniyā puṇṇāya puṇṇamāya rattiyā rājāmaccaparivuto uparipāsādavaragato nisinno hoti.
content: 當時，在已滿四個月的迦刺底迦月滿月日、在十五[[cātuddasiṃ pañcadasiṃ#那個布薩日]]的滿月夜晚，摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子被國王的大臣們圍繞，到殊勝高樓上層坐下。

original: Atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto tadahuposathe udānaṃ udānesi–
content: 那時，摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子在那個布薩日吟出[[udānaṃ#優陀那]]：

original: ‘‘ ramaṇīyā vata bho dosinā ratti, abhirūpā vata bho dosinā ratti, dassanīyā vata bho dosinā ratti, pāsādikā vata bho dosinā ratti, lakkhaññā vata bho dosinā ratti.
content: 「[[bho#先生]]！明月之夜確實是能被喜樂的，先生！明月之夜確實是殊妙的，先生！明月之夜確實是好看的，先生！明月之夜確實是愉快的，先生！明月之夜確實是祥瑞的，

original: Kaṃ nu khvajja samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā payirupāseyyāma, yaṃ no payirupāsato cittaṃ pasīdeyyā’’ ti?
content: 現在，我們應該拜訪哪位[[samaṇa#沙門]]或[[brāhmaṇaṃ#婆羅門]]，凡當我們拜訪時，心會明淨？」(150)

original: 151. Evaṃ vutte, aññataro rājāmacco rājānaṃ māgadhaṃ ajātasattuṃ vedehiputtaṃ etadavoca–
content: 在這麼說時，某位國王的大臣對摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子說這個：

original: ‘‘ ayaṃ, deva, pūraṇo kassapo saṅghī ceva gaṇī ca gaṇācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthakaro sādhusammato bahujanassa rattaññū cirapabbajito addhagato vayoanuppatto.
content: 「陛下！這位有團體的、有群眾的、群眾的老師、有名聲的知名開宗祖師、被眾人認定善的富蘭那迦葉是有經驗的、長久出家的、老年的、到達老年的，

original: Taṃ devo pūraṇaṃ kassapaṃ payirupāsatu.
content: 請陛下訪問那位富蘭那迦葉，

original: Appeva nāma devassa pūraṇaṃ kassapaṃ payirupāsato cittaṃ pasīdeyyā’’ ti.
content: 或許當陛下訪問富蘭那迦葉時，心會明淨。」

original: Evaṃ vutte, rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto tuṇhī ahosi.
content: 在這麼說時，摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子保持沈默。(151)

original: 152. Aññataropi kho rājāmacco rājānaṃ māgadhaṃ ajātasattuṃ vedehiputtaṃ etadavoca–
content: 某位國王的大臣也對摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子說這個：

original: ‘‘ ayaṃ, deva, makkhali gosālo saṅghī ceva gaṇī ca gaṇācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthakaro sādhusammato bahujanassa rattaññū cirapabbajito addhagato vayoanuppatto.
content: 「陛下！這位有團體的、有群眾的、群眾的老師、有名聲的知名開宗祖師、被眾人認定善的末迦利瞿舍羅是有經驗的、長久出家的、老年的、到達老年的，

original: Taṃ devo makkhaliṃ gosālaṃ payirupāsatu.
content: 請陛下訪問那位末迦利瞿舍羅，

original: Appeva nāma devassa makkhaliṃ gosālaṃ payirupāsato cittaṃ pasīdeyyā’’ ti.
content: 或許當陛下訪問末迦利瞿舍羅時，心會明淨。」

original: Evaṃ vutte, rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto tuṇhī ahosi.
content: 在這麼說時，摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子保持沈默。(152)

original: 153. Aññataropi kho rājāmacco rājānaṃ māgadhaṃ ajātasattuṃ vedehiputtaṃ etadavoca–
content: 某位國王的大臣也對摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子說這個：

original: ‘‘ ayaṃ, deva, ajito kesakambalo saṅghī ceva gaṇī ca gaṇācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthakaro sādhusammato bahujanassa rattaññū cirapabbajito addhagato vayoanuppatto.
content: 「陛下！這位有團體的、有群眾的、群眾的老師、有名聲的知名開宗祖師、被眾人認定善的阿夷多翅舍欽婆羅是有經驗的、長久出家的、老年的、到達老年的，

original: Taṃ devo ajitaṃ kesakambalaṃ payirupāsatu.
content: 請陛下訪問那位阿夷多翅舍欽婆羅，

original: Appeva nāma devassa ajitaṃ kesakambalaṃ payirupāsato cittaṃ pasīdeyyā’’ ti.
content: 或許當陛下訪問阿夷多翅舍欽婆羅時，心會明淨。」

original: Evaṃ vutte, rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto tuṇhī ahosi.
content: 在這麼說時，摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子保持沈默。(153)

original: 154. Aññataropi kho rājāmacco rājānaṃ māgadhaṃ ajātasattuṃ vedehiputtaṃ etadavoca–
content: 某位國王的大臣也對摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子說這個：

original: ‘‘ ayaṃ, deva, pakudho[ pakuddho( sī.)] kaccāyano saṅghī ceva gaṇī ca gaṇācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthakaro sādhusammato bahujanassa rattaññū cirapabbajito addhagato vayoanuppatto.
content: 「陛下！這位有團體的、有群眾的、群眾的老師、有名聲的知名開宗祖師、被眾人認定善的浮陀迦旃延是有經驗的、長久出家的、老年的、到達老年的，

original: Taṃ devo pakudhaṃ kaccāyanaṃ payirupāsatu.
content: 請陛下訪問那位浮陀迦旃延，

original: Appeva nāma devassa pakudhaṃ kaccāyanaṃ payirupāsato cittaṃ pasīdeyyā’’ ti.
content: 或許當陛下訪問浮陀迦旃延時，心會明淨。」

original: Evaṃ vutte, rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto tuṇhī ahosi.
content: 在這麼說時，摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子保持沈默。(154)

original: 155. Aññataropi kho rājāmacco rājānaṃ māgadhaṃ ajātasattuṃ vedehiputtaṃ etadavoca–
content: 某位國王的大臣也對摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子說這個：

original: ‘‘ ayaṃ, deva, sañcayo[ sañjayo( sī. syā.)] belaṭṭhaputto[ bellaṭṭhiputto( sī.), velaṭṭhaputto( syā.)] saṅghī ceva gaṇī ca gaṇācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthakaro sādhusammato bahujanassa rattaññū cirapabbajito addhagato vayoanuppatto.
content: 「陛下！這位有團體的、有群眾的、群眾的老師、有名聲的知名開宗祖師、被眾人認定善的散惹耶毘羅梨子是有經驗的、長久出家的、老年的、到達老年的，

original: Taṃ devo sañcayaṃ belaṭṭhaputtaṃ payirupāsatu.
content: 請陛下訪問那位散惹耶毘羅梨子，

original: Appeva nāma devassa sañcayaṃ belaṭṭhaputtaṃ payirupāsato cittaṃ pasīdeyyā’’ ti.
content: 或許當陛下訪問散惹耶毘羅梨子時，心會明淨。」

original: Evaṃ vutte, rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto tuṇhī ahosi.
content: 在這麼說時，摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子保持沈默。(155)

original: 156. Aññataropi kho rājāmacco rājānaṃ māgadhaṃ ajātasattuṃ vedehiputtaṃ etadavoca–
content: 某位國王的大臣也對摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子說這個：

original: ‘‘ ayaṃ, deva, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto[ nāthaputto( sī.), nātaputto( pī.)] saṅghī ceva gaṇī ca gaṇācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthakaro sādhusammato bahujanassa rattaññū cirapabbajito addhagato vayoanuppatto.
content: 「陛下！這位有團體的、有群眾的、群眾的老師、有名聲的知名開宗祖師、被眾人認定善的尼乾陀若提子是有經驗的、長久出家的、老年的、到達老年的，

original: Taṃ devo nigaṇṭhaṃ nāṭaputtaṃ payirupāsatu.
content: 請陛下訪問那位尼乾陀若提子，

original: Appeva nāma devassa nigaṇṭhaṃ nāṭaputtaṃ payirupāsato cittaṃ pasīdeyyā’’ ti.
content: 或許當陛下訪問尼乾陀若提子時，心會明淨。」

original: Evaṃ vutte, rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto tuṇhī ahosi.
content: 在這麼說時，摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子保持沈默。(156)

original: Komārabhaccajīvakakathā
content: 養子耆婆的談論

original: 157. Tena kho pana samayena jīvako komārabhacco rañño māgadhassa ajātasattussa vedehiputtassa avidūre tuṇhībhūto nisinno hoti.
content: 當時，養子耆婆在摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子的不遠處沉默地坐著。

original: Atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto jīvakaṃ komārabhaccaṃ etadavoca–
content: 那時，摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子對養子耆婆說這個：

original: ‘‘ tvaṃ pana, samma jīvaka, kiṃ tuṇhī’’ ti?
content: 「親愛的耆婆！那麼，你為何沉默？」

original: ‘‘ Ayaṃ, deva, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho amhākaṃ ambavane viharati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhateḷasehi bhikkhusatehi.
content: 「陛下！這位[[bhagavā#世尊]]、[[arahaṃ#阿羅漢]]、[[sammāsambuddhaṃ#遍正覺者]]與一千二百五十位[[bhikkhu#比丘]]的大比丘[[saṅgha#僧團]]一起住在我們的芒果園中。

original: Taṃ kho pana bhagavantaṃ[ bhagavantaṃ gotamaṃ( sī. ka. pī.)] evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato–
content: 又，對那位世尊，這樣的好名聲已傳播：

original: ‘ itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ ti.
content: 『像這樣，那位世尊是[[arahaṃ#阿羅漢]]、[[sammāsambuddhaṃ#遍正覺者]]、[[vijjācaraṇasampanno#明行具足者]]、[[sugato#善逝]]、[[lokavidū#世間知者]]、[[anuttaro purisadammasārathi#應該被調御人的無上調御者]]、[[satthā devamanussānaṃ#天-人們的大師]]、[[buddho#佛陀]]、[[bhagavā#世尊]]。』

original: Taṃ devo bhagavantaṃ payirupāsatu.
content: 請陛下訪問那位世尊，

original: Appeva nāma devassa bhagavantaṃ payirupāsato cittaṃ pasīdeyyā’ ti.
content: 或許當陛下訪問世尊時，心會明淨。」(157)

original: 158.‘‘ Tena hi, samma jīvaka, hatthiyānāni kappāpehī’’ ti.
content: 「親愛的耆婆！那樣的話，請你準備象乘。」

original: ‘‘ Evaṃ, devā’’ ti kho jīvako komārabhacco rañño māgadhassa ajātasattussa vedehiputtassa paṭissuṇitvā pañcamattāni hatthinikāsatāni kappāpetvā rañño ca ārohaṇīyaṃ nāgaṃ, rañño māgadhassa ajātasattussa vedehiputtassa paṭivedesi–
content: 「是的，陛下！」養子耆婆回答摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子後，準備約五百頭母象與應該被國王登上的[[nāga#龍象]]後，回報摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子：

original: ‘‘ kappitāni kho te, deva, hatthiyānāni, yassadāni kālaṃ maññasī’’ ti.
content: 「陛下！那些是已準備的象乘，現在是那個[[kālaṃ maññasī#你考量的時間]]。」(158)

original: 159. Atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto pañcasu hatthinikāsatesu paccekā itthiyo āropetvā ārohaṇīyaṃ nāgaṃ abhiruhitvā ukkāsu dhāriyamānāsu rājagahamhā niyyāsi mahaccarājānubhāvena, yena jīvakassa komārabhaccassa ambavanaṃ tena pāyāsi.
content: 那時，摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子在五百頭母象上各自地使一女子登上後，登上應該被登上的龍象後，在使火把被持下，以國王威力盛況從王舍城出發，前往養子耆婆的芒果園。

original: Atha kho rañño māgadhassa ajātasattussa vedehiputtassa avidūre ambavanassa ahudeva bhayaṃ, ahu chambhitattaṃ, ahu lomahaṃso.
content: 那時，摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子在芒果園不遠處就變成害怕，變成僵硬狀態，變成[[lomāni haṭṭhāni#身毛豎立的]]。

original: Atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto bhīto saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto jīvakaṃ komārabhaccaṃ etadavoca–
content: 那時，害怕的、驚怖的、生起身毛豎立的摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子對養子耆婆說這個：

original: ‘‘ kacci maṃ, samma jīvaka, na vañcesi?
content: 「親愛的耆婆！你沒欺騙我吧？

original: Kacci maṃ, samma jīvaka, na palambhesi?
content: 親愛的耆婆！你沒欺瞞我吧？

original: Kacci maṃ, samma jīvaka, na paccatthikānaṃ desi ?
content: 親愛的耆婆！你沒把我給與敵人吧？

original: Kathañhi nāma tāva mahato bhikkhusaṅghassa aḍḍhateḷasānaṃ bhikkhusatānaṃ neva khipitasaddo bhavissati, na ukkāsitasaddo na nigghoso’’ ti.
content: 一千二百五十位比丘那麼多的大比丘僧團怎麼會既沒有噴嚏聲，也沒有清喉嚨聲，也沒有出聲？」

original: ‘ ‘ Mā bhāyi, mahārāja, mā bhāyi, mahārāja.
content: 「大王！你不要害怕！大王！你不要害怕！

original: Na taṃ deva, vañcemi;
content: 陛下！我沒欺騙你，

original: na taṃ, deva, palambhāmi ;
content: 陛下！我沒欺瞞你，

original: na taṃ, deva, paccatthikānaṃ demi.
content: 陛下！我沒把你給與敵人，

original: Abhikkama, mahārāja, abhikkama, mahārāja, ete maṇḍalamāḷe dīpā[ padīpā( sī. syā.)] jhāyantī’’ ti.
content: 大王！請你前進，大王！請你前進，在圓亭棚處，這些燈火燃燒。」(159)

original: Sāmaññaphalapucchā
content: 沙門果的問題

original: 160. Atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto yāvatikā nāgassa bhūmi nāgena gantvā, nāgā paccorohitvā, pattikova[ padikova( syā.)] yena maṇḍalamāḷassa dvāraṃ tenupasaṅkami;
content: 那時，摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子以龍象一直走到龍象所及之地、再下龍象後，就步行去圓亭棚的門。

original: upasaṅkamitvā jīvakaṃ komārabhaccaṃ etadavoca–
content: 抵達後，對養子耆婆說這個：

original: ‘‘ kahaṃ pana, samma jīvaka, bhagavā’’ ti?
content: 「親愛的耆婆！那麼，世尊在哪裡？」

original: ‘‘ Eso, mahārāja, bhagavā;
content: 「大王！這位是世尊，

original: eso, mahārāja, bhagavā majjhimaṃ thambhaṃ nissāya puratthābhimukho nisinno purakkhato bhikkhusaṅghassā’’ ti.
content: 大王！這位是世尊：靠著中央柱子面向東、在比丘僧團的前面坐著者。」(160)

original: 161. Atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami;
content: 那時，摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子去見世尊。

original: upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
content: 抵達後，在一旁站立。

original: Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto tuṇhībhūtaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ anuviloketvā rahadamiva vippasannaṃ udānaṃ udānesi–
content: 在一旁站立的摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子環視一一保持沈默、如明淨湖的比丘僧團後，吟出優陀那：

original: ‘‘ iminā me upasamena udayabhaddo[ udāyibhaddo( sī. pī.)] kumāro samannāgato hotu, yenetarahi upasamena bhikkhusaṅgho samannāgato’’ ti.
content: 「願我的男孩生賢具備這個寂靜：該寂靜現在被比丘僧團具備。」

original: ‘‘ Agamā kho tvaṃ, mahārāja, yathāpeman’’ ti.
‘‘ Piyo me, bhante, udayabhaddo kumāro.
content: 「[[bhante#大德]]！我有可愛的男孩生賢。

original: Iminā me, bhante, upasamena udayabhaddo kumāro samannāgato hotu yenetarahi upasamena bhikkhusaṅgho samannāgato’’ ti.
content: 大德！願我的男孩生賢具備這個寂靜：該寂靜現在被比丘僧團具備。」(161)

original: 162. Atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā, bhikkhusaṅghassa añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā , ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
content: 那時，摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子向世尊[[abhivādetvā#問訊]]後，向比丘僧團[[añjaliṃ#合掌]]後，在一旁坐下。

original: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca–
content: 在一旁坐下的摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子對世尊說這個：

original: ‘‘ puccheyyāmahaṃ, bhante, bhagavantaṃ kiñcideva desaṃ[ kiñcideva desaṃ lesamattaṃ( syā. kaṃ. ka.)];
content: 「大德！願我就某點詢問世尊，

original: sace me bhagavā okāsaṃ karoti pañhassa veyyākaraṇāyā’’ ti.
content: 如果世尊對我的問題解答給機會。」

original: ‘‘ Puccha, mahārāja, yadākaṅkhasī’’ ti.
content: 「大王！請你詢問，如果你希望。」(162)

original: 163.‘‘ Yathā nu kho imāni, bhante, puthusippāyatanāni, seyyathidaṃ– hatthārohā assārohā rathikā dhanuggahā celakā calakā piṇḍadāyakā uggā rājaputtā pakkhandino mahānāgā sūrā cammayodhino dāsikaputtā āḷārikā kappakā nhāpakā[ nahāpikā( sī.), nhāpikā( syā.)] sūdā mālākārā rajakā pesakārā naḷakārā kumbhakārā gaṇakā muddikā, yāni vā panaññānipi evaṃgatāni puthusippāyatanāni, te diṭṭheva dhamme sandiṭṭhikaṃ sippaphalaṃ upajīvanti;
content: 「大德！如這些個個技能處，即：騎象兵、騎馬兵、戰車兵、弓箭兵、軍旗兵、參謀、伙食兵、[[uggā rājaputtā#尊貴王族戰士]]、突擊兵、[[mahānāgā#大龍戰士]]、勇士、穿胸甲的戰士、死忠奴隸兵(女奴隸之子)、廚師、理髮師、浴僕、作甜食者、作花環者、洗染匠、編織匠、蘆葦匠、製陶器者、會計師、查驗員，又或凡其它也來到這樣個個技能處，他們在當生中直接可見地依技能果生活，

original: te tena attānaṃ sukhenti pīṇenti[ pīnenti( katthaci)], mātāpitaro sukhenti pīṇenti, puttadāraṃ sukhenti pīṇenti, mittāmacce sukhenti pīṇenti, samaṇabrāhmaṇesu[ samaṇesu brāhmaṇesu( ka.)] uddhaggikaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ patiṭṭhapenti sovaggikaṃ sukhavipākaṃ saggasaṃvattanikaṃ.
content: 他們以那個使自己快樂、喜悅；使父母快樂、喜悅；使妻兒快樂、喜悅；使朋友同事快樂、喜悅，在沙門婆羅門們上使高的、導致生天的、安樂果報的、轉起天界的供養建立。

original: Sakkā nu kho, bhante, evameva diṭṭheva dhamme sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ paññapetun’’ ti?
content: 同樣的，大德！你能夠告知在當生中{{note|trigger=直接可見的|text=「現得(DA.27)；現(AA)」，南傳作「直接可見的」(sandiṭṭhikaṃ，另譯為「現世的；現証的；自見的」)，菩提比丘長老英譯為「直接可見的；此時此地可見的」(directly visible, SN ; visible here and now, MN)。}}沙門果？」(163)

original: 164.‘‘ Abhijānāsi no tvaṃ, mahārāja, imaṃ pañhaṃ aññe samaṇabrāhmaṇe pucchitā’’ ti ?
content: 「大王！你記得(證知)在其他沙門婆羅門處已詢問這些問題嗎？」

original: ‘‘ Abhijānāmahaṃ, bhante, imaṃ pañhaṃ aññe samaṇabrāhmaṇe pucchitā’’ ti.
content: 「大德！我記得在其他沙門婆羅門處已詢問這些問題。」

original: ‘‘ Yathā kathaṃ pana te, mahārāja, byākariṃsu, sace te agaru bhāsassū’’ ti.
content: 「大王！那麼，他們如怎樣解答呢？如果對你不麻煩，請你說。」

original: ‘‘ Na kho me, bhante, garu, yatthassa bhagavā nisinno, bhagavantarūpo vā’’ ti[ cāti( sī. ka.)].
content: 「大德！對我不麻煩，如果於該處坐著的是世尊或世尊形色者。」

original: ‘‘ Tena hi, mahārāja, bhāsassū’’ ti.
content: 「大王！那樣的話，請你說。」(164)

original: Pūraṇakassapavādo
content: 富蘭那迦葉之論

original: 165.‘‘ Ekamidāhaṃ, bhante, samayaṃ yena pūraṇo kassapo tenupasaṅkami;
content: 「大德！有這一次，我去見富蘭那迦葉。

original: upasaṅkamitvā pūraṇena kassapena saddhiṃ sammodiṃ.
content: 抵達後與富蘭那迦葉一起互相問候。

original: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃ.
content: 交換應該被互相問候的友好交談後，在一旁坐下。

original: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho ahaṃ, bhante, pūraṇaṃ kassapaṃ etadavocaṃ–
content: 在一旁坐下的我對富蘭那迦葉說這個：

original: ‘ yathā nu kho imāni, bho kassapa, puthusippāyatanāni, seyyathidaṃ– hatthārohā assārohā rathikā dhanuggahā celakā calakā piṇḍadāyakā uggā rājaputtā pakkhandino mahānāgā sūrā cammayodhino dāsikaputtā āḷārikā kappakā nhāpakā sūdā mālākārā rajakā pesakārā naḷakārā kumbhakārā gaṇakā muddikā, yāni vā panaññānipi evaṃgatāni puthusippāyatanāni- te diṭṭheva dhamme sandiṭṭhikaṃ sippaphalaṃ upajīvanti;
content: 『迦葉尊師！如這些個個技能處，即：騎象兵、騎馬兵、戰車兵、弓箭兵、軍旗兵、參謀、伙食兵、尊貴王族戰士、突擊兵、大龍戰士、勇士、穿胸甲的戰士、死忠奴隸兵、廚師、理髮師、浴僕、作甜食者、作花環者、洗染匠、編織匠、蘆葦匠、製陶器者、會計師、查驗員，又或凡其它也來到這樣個個技能處，他們在當生中直接可見地依技能果生活，

original: te tena attānaṃ sukhenti pīṇenti, mātāpitaro sukhenti pīṇenti, puttadāraṃ sukhenti pīṇenti, mittāmacce sukhenti pīṇenti, samaṇabrāhmaṇesu uddhaggikaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ patiṭṭhapenti sovaggikaṃ sukhavipākaṃ saggasaṃvattanikaṃ.
content: 他們以那個使自己快樂、喜悅；使父母快樂、喜悅；使妻兒快樂、喜悅；使朋友同事快樂、喜悅，在沙門婆羅門們上使高的、導致生天的、安樂果報的、轉起天界的供養建立。

original: Sakkā nu kho, bho kassapa, evameva diṭṭheva dhamme sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ paññapetun’ ti?
content: 同樣的，大德！你能夠告知在當生中直接可見的沙門果？』(165)

original: 166.‘‘ Evaṃ vutte, bhante, pūraṇo kassapo maṃ etadavoca–
content: 大德！在這麼說時，富蘭那迦葉對我說這個：

original: ‘ karoto kho, mahārāja, kārayato, chindato chedāpayato, pacato pācāpayato socayato, socāpayato, kilamato kilamāpayato, phandato phandāpayato, pāṇamatipātāpayato, adinnaṃ ādiyato, sandhiṃ chindato, nillopaṃ harato, ekāgārikaṃ karoto, paripanthe tiṭṭhato, paradāraṃ gacchato, musā bhaṇato, karoto na karīyati pāpaṃ.
content: 『大王！作者、[[karoto kārayato#使他作者]]，切斷者、[[chindato chedāpayato#使他切斷者]]，折磨者、[[pacato pācāpayato#使他折磨者]]，造成悲傷者、使他造成悲傷者，造成疲勞者、使他造成疲勞者，造成悸動者、使他造成悸動者，殺生者，[[adinnādānā#未被給與的拿取]]者、[[sandhiṃ chindato#入侵人家者]]、奪取(搬運)掠奪物者、作盜匪者、[[paripanthepi tiṭṭhanti#攔路搶劫]]者，通姦(走入)他人的妻子者，虛妄地說者：無惡被作，

original: Khurapariyantena cepi cakkena yo imissā pathaviyā pāṇe ekaṃ maṃsakhalaṃ ekaṃ maṃsapuñjaṃ kareyya, natthi tatonidānaṃ pāpaṃ, natthi pāpassa āgamo.
content: 如果以剃刀輪周邊使在這大地上的生類轉成一肉聚、一肉堆，從那個因由沒有惡的，沒有惡的傳來；

original: Dakkhiṇaṃ cepi gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya hananto ghātento chindanto chedāpento pacanto pācāpento, natthi tatonidānaṃ pāpaṃ, natthi pāpassa āgamo.
content: 如果走在恒河南岸，殺者、使他殺者，切斷者、使他切斷者，折磨者、使他折磨者，從那個因由沒有惡的，沒有惡的傳來；

original: Uttarañcepi gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya dadanto dāpento yajanto yajāpento, natthi tatonidānaṃ puññaṃ, natthi puññassa āgamo.
content: 如果走在恒河北岸，施與者、使他施與者，祭祀者、使他祭祀者，從那個因由沒有福德，沒有福德的傳來；

original: Dānena damena saṃyamena saccavajjena natthi puññaṃ, natthi puññassa āgamo’ ti.
content: 以布施，以調御，以抑制，以真實所言的，沒有福德，沒有福德的傳來。』

original: Itthaṃ kho me, bhante, pūraṇo kassapo sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ puṭṭho samāno akiriyaṃ byākāsi.
content: 大德！像這樣，當富蘭那迦葉被我詢問直接可見的沙門果時，解說[[akiriyavādā#無作業]]。

original: ‘ ‘ Seyyathāpi, bhante, ambaṃ vā puṭṭho labujaṃ byākareyya , labujaṃ vā puṭṭho ambaṃ byākareyya;
content: 大德！猶如被詢問芒果，解答波羅蜜果，或被詢問波羅蜜果，解答芒果。

original: evameva kho me, bhante, pūraṇo kassapo sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ puṭṭho samāno akiriyaṃ byākāsi.
content: 同樣的，大德！當富蘭那迦葉被我詢問直接可見的沙門果時，解說無作業。

original: Tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, etadahosi–
content: 大德！我想這個：

original: ‘ kathañhi nāma mādiso samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā vijite vasantaṃ apasādetabbaṃ maññeyyā’ ti.
content: 『像我這樣的，怎麼會想住在領土中的沙門或婆羅門應該被貶低？』

original: So kho ahaṃ, bhante, pūraṇassa kassapassa bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandiṃ nappaṭikkosiṃ.
content: 大德！那個我對富蘭那迦葉的所說既不歡喜，也不斥責。

original: Anabhinanditvā appaṭikositvā anattamano, anattamanavācaṃ anicchāretvā, tameva vācaṃ anuggaṇhanto anikkujjanto[ anikkujjento( syā. kaṃ. ka.)] uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṃ[ pakkāmiṃ( sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)].
content: 不歡喜、不斥責後，不悅意地不發不悅意之語，就對那個言語不拿起地、不傾覆地從座位起來後離開。(166)

original: Makkhaligosālavādo
content: 末迦利瞿舍羅之論

original: 167.‘‘ Ekamidāhaṃ, bhante, samayaṃ yena makkhali gosālo tenupasaṅkamiṃ;
content: 「大德！有這一次，我去見末迦利瞿舍羅。

original: upasaṅkamitvā makkhalinā gosālena saddhiṃ sammodiṃ.
content: 抵達後與末迦利瞿舍羅一起互相問候。

original: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃ.
content: 交換應該被互相問候的友好交談後，在一旁坐下。

original: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho ahaṃ, bhante, makkhaliṃ gosālaṃ etadavocaṃ–
content: 在一旁坐下的我對末迦利瞿舍羅說這個：

original: ‘ yathā nu kho imāni, bho gosāla, puthusippāyatanāni… pe… sakkā nu kho, bho gosāla, evameva diṭṭheva dhamme sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ paññapetun’ ti?
content: 『瞿舍羅尊師！如這些個個技能處……（中略）同樣的，瞿舍羅尊師！你能夠告知在當生中直接可見的沙門果？』(167)

original: 168.‘‘ Evaṃ vutte, bhante, makkhali gosālo maṃ etadavoca–
content: 大德！在這麼說時，末迦利瞿舍羅對我說這個：

original: ‘ natthi mahārāja hetu natthi paccayo sattānaṃ saṃkilesāya, ahetū[ ahetu( katthaci)] apaccayā sattā saṃkilissanti.
content: 『大王！對眾生的污染，沒有因沒有[[paccayā#緣]]，眾生們無因無緣地被污染；

original: Natthi hetu, natthi paccayo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā, ahetū apaccayā sattā visujjhanti.
content: 對眾生的清淨，沒有因沒有緣，眾生們無因無緣地變成清淨，

original: Natthi attakāre, natthi parakāre, natthi purisakāre, natthi balaṃ, natthi vīriyaṃ, natthi purisathāmo, natthi purisaparakkamo .
content: 沒有[[attakāre#自作者]]，沒有他作者，沒有力，沒有活力，沒有人的力量，沒有人的努力；

original: Sabbe sattā sabbe pāṇā sabbe bhūtā sabbe jīvā avasā abalā avīriyā niyatisaṅgatibhāvapariṇatā chasvevābhijātīsu sukhadukkhaṃ[ sukhañca dukkhañca( syā.)] paṭisaṃvedenti.
content: 一切眾生、一切生物類、一切生存類、[[sabbe jīvā#一切生命]]無自在力，無力，無活力，被命運、意外、[[saṅgati#本性變化]]而[[chasvevābhijātīsu#在六等級中]]感受苦樂。

original: Cuddasa kho panimāni yonipamukhasatasahassāni saṭṭhi ca satāni cha ca satāni pañca ca kammuno satāni pañca ca kammāni tīṇi ca kammāni kamme ca aḍḍhakamme ca dvaṭṭhipaṭipadā dvaṭṭhantarakappā chaḷābhijātiyo aṭṭha purisabhūmiyo ekūnapaññāsa ājīvakasate ekūnapaññāsa paribbājakasate ekūnapaññāsa nāgāvāsasate vīse indriyasate tiṃse nirayasate chattiṃsa rajodhātuyo satta saññīgabbhā satta asaññīgabbhā satta nigaṇṭhigabbhā satta devā satta mānusā satta pisācā satta sarā satta pavuṭā[ sapuṭā( ka.), pabuṭā( sī.)] satta pavuṭasatāni satta papātā satta papātasatāni satta supinā satta supinasatāni cullāsīti mahākappino[ mahākappuno( ka. sī. pī.)] satasahassāni, yāni bāle ca paṇḍite ca sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhassantaṃ karissanti.
content: [[cuddasa kho panimāni yonipamukhasatasahassāni saṭṭhi ca satāni cha ca#又有這一百四十萬六千六百最上首之胎]]、五百種業、五種業、三種業、業、半業，有六十二道、六十二中間劫、六等級、[[aṭṭhapurisabhūmiyo#人之八地]]、四千九百種邪命外道、四千九百種遊行者、四千九百種龍之住所、二千根、三千地獄、三十六塵界、七有想胎、七無想胎、[[satta nigaṇṭhigabbhā#七無結胎]]、七種天、七種人、七種惡鬼、七座湖、七種結節、七百種結節、七座斷崖又七百座斷崖、七種夢、七百種夢、八百四十萬大劫，凡愚者與賢智者們[[sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā#流轉輪迴後]]，將[[antamakāsi dukkhassā#作苦的終結]]，

original: Tattha natthi ‘‘ imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā aparipakkaṃ vā kammaṃ paripācessāmi, paripakkaṃ vā kammaṃ phussa phussa byantiṃ karissāmī’ ti hevaṃ natthi.
content: 在那裡，沒有：「我將以這個戒，或[[vata#禁戒]]，或苦行，或梵行使未遍熟之業遍熟，或將以一再觸達使已遍熟之業作終結。」確實不這樣，

original: Doṇamite sukhadukkhe pariyantakate saṃsāre , natthi hāyanavaḍḍhane, natthi ukkaṃsāvakaṃse.
content: 對一桶量[固定]的苦樂，對作限制的輪迴，沒有減退、增加，沒有優秀、貶抑，

original: Seyyathāpi nāma suttaguḷe khitte nibbeṭhiyamānameva paleti, evameva bāle ca paṇḍite ca sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhassantaṃ karissantī’ ti.
content: 猶如在線球被投出時，[[nibbeṭhiyamānameva paleti#當被解開時它就逃走]][SN.24.8]。同樣的，愚者或賢智者們流轉輪迴後，將作苦的終結。』[MN.76](168)

original: 169.‘‘ Itthaṃ kho me, bhante, makkhali gosālo sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ puṭṭho samāno saṃsārasuddhiṃ byākāsi.
content: 大德！像這樣，當末迦利瞿舍羅被我詢問直接可見的沙門果時，解說輪迴的純淨。

original: Seyyathāpi, bhante, ambaṃ vā puṭṭho labujaṃ byākareyya, labujaṃ vā puṭṭho ambaṃ byākareyya;
content: 大德！猶如被詢問芒果，解答波羅蜜果，或被詢問波羅蜜果，解答芒果。

original: evameva kho me, bhante, makkhali gosālo sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ puṭṭho samāno saṃsārasuddhiṃ byākāsi.
content: 同樣的，大德！當末迦利瞿舍羅被我詢問直接可見的沙門果時，解說輪迴的純淨。

original: Tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, etadahosi–
content: 大德！我想這個：

original: ‘ kathañhi nāma mādiso samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā vijite vasantaṃ apasādetabbaṃ maññeyyā’ ti.
content: 『像我這樣的，怎麼會想住在領土中的沙門或婆羅門應該被貶低？』

original: So kho ahaṃ, bhante, makkhalissa gosālassa bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandiṃ nappaṭikkosiṃ.
content: 大德！那個我對末迦利瞿舍羅的所說既不歡喜，也不斥責。

original: Anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā anattamano, anattamanavācaṃ anicchāretvā, tameva vācaṃ anuggaṇhanto anikkujjanto uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṃ.
content: 不歡喜、不斥責後，不悅意地不發不悅意之語，就對那個言語不拿起地、不傾覆地從座位起來後離開。(169)

original: Ajitakesakambalavādo
content: 阿夷多翅舍欽婆羅之論

original: 170.‘‘ Ekamidāhaṃ, bhante, samayaṃ yena ajito kesakambalo tenupasaṅkamiṃ;
content: 「大德！有這一次，我去見阿夷多翅舍欽婆羅。

original: upasaṅkamitvā ajitena kesakambalena saddhiṃ sammodiṃ.
content: 抵達後與阿夷多翅舍欽婆羅一起互相問候。

original: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃ.
content: 交換應該被互相問候的友好交談後，在一旁坐下。

original: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho ahaṃ, bhante, ajitaṃ kesakambalaṃ etadavocaṃ–
content: 在一旁坐下的我對阿夷多翅舍欽婆羅說這個：

original: ‘ yathā nu kho imāni, bho ajita, puthusippāyatanāni… pe… sakkā nu kho, bho ajita, evameva diṭṭheva dhamme sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ paññapetun’ ti?
content: 『阿夷多尊師！如這些個個技能處……（中略）同樣的，阿夷多尊師！你能夠告知在當生中直接可見的沙門果？』(170)

original: 171.‘‘ Evaṃ vutte, bhante, ajito kesakambalo maṃ etadavoca–
content: 大德！在這麼說時，阿夷多翅舍欽婆羅對我說這個：

original: ‘ natthi, mahārāja, dinnaṃ , natthi yiṭṭhaṃ, natthi hutaṃ, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, natthi ayaṃ loko[ paraloko( syā.)], natthi paro loko, natthi mātā, natthi pitā, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā[ samaggatā( ka.), samaggatā( syā.)] sammāpaṭipannā, ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedenti.
content: 『大王！沒有施與的[果報]，沒有祭祀的，沒有供養的，沒有善作惡作業的果、果報，沒有這個世間，沒有其他世間，沒有母親，沒有父親，沒有[[opapātikā#化生]]眾生，在世間中沒有[[sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā#正行的]]、正行道的[[samaṇa#沙門]]、[[brāhmaṇaṃ#婆羅門]]凡以證智自作證後告知這個世間與其他世間。

original: Cātumahābhūtiko ayaṃ puriso, yadā kālaṅkaroti, pathavī pathavikāyaṃ anupeti anupagacchati, āpo āpokāyaṃ anupeti anupagacchati, tejo tejokāyaṃ anupeti anupagacchati, vāyo vāyokāyaṃ anupeti anupagacchati, ākāsaṃ indriyāni saṅkamanti.
content: [[cātummahābhūta#四大]]所成的這位男子當命終時，地沒入、隨行地身，水沒入、隨行水身，火沒入、隨行火身，風沒入、隨行風身，諸根轉移到虛空，

original: Āsandipañcamā purisā mataṃ ādāya gacchanti.
content: [四]人與[[āḷāhanā#長椅為第五]]抬走死者，

original: Yāvāḷāhanā padāni paññāyanti.
content: 直到墓地為止[哀悼]諸句被知道，

original: Kāpotakāni aṭṭhīni bhavanti, bhassantā āhutiyo.
content: 骨頭成為灰白色，[[bhassantā āhutiyo#祭品成為落下的]]，

original: Dattupaññattaṃ yadidaṃ dānaṃ.
content: 布施即被愚者安立的，

original: Tesaṃ tucchaṃ musā vilāpo ye keci atthikavādaṃ vadanti.
content: 凡任何說[布施之類][[natthikavādo/natthikavādā#虛無論]]者，他們的[言論]全是空虛的、[[musā vilāpo#虛妄的、無價值的話]]，

original: Bāle ca paṇḍite ca kāyassa bhedā ucchijjanti vinassanti, na honti paraṃ maraṇā’ ti.
content: 愚者與賢智者以身體的崩解被斷滅、消失；死後不存在。』[SN.24.5, MN.76](171)

original: 172.‘‘ Itthaṃ kho me, bhante, ajito kesakambalo sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ puṭṭho samāno ucchedaṃ byākāsi.
content: 大德！像這樣，當阿夷多翅舍欽婆羅被我詢問直接可見的沙門果時，解說斷滅。

original: Seyyathāpi, bhante, ambaṃ vā puṭṭho labujaṃ byākareyya , labujaṃ vā puṭṭho ambaṃ byākareyya;
content: 大德！猶如被詢問芒果，解答波羅蜜果，或被詢問波羅蜜果，解答芒果。

original: evameva kho me, bhante, ajito kesakambalo sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ puṭṭho samāno ucchedaṃ byākāsi.
content: 同樣的，大德！當阿夷多翅舍欽婆羅被我詢問直接可見的沙門果時，解說斷滅。

original: Tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, etadahosi–
content: 大德！我想這個：

original: ‘ kathañhi nāma mādiso samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā vijite vasantaṃ apasādetabbaṃ maññeyyā’ ti.
content: 『像我這樣的，怎麼會想住在領土中的沙門或婆羅門應該被貶低？』

original: So kho ahaṃ, bhante, ajitassa kesakambalassa bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandiṃ nappaṭikkosiṃ.
content: 大德！那個我對阿夷多翅舍欽婆羅的所說既不歡喜，也不斥責。

original: Anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā anattamano anattamanavācaṃ anicchāretvā tameva vācaṃ anuggaṇhanto anikkujjanto uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṃ.
content: 不歡喜、不斥責後，不悅意地不發不悅意之語，就對那個言語不拿起地、不傾覆地從座位起來後離開。(172)

original: Pakudhakaccāyanavādo
content: 浮陀迦旃延之論

original: 173.‘‘ Ekamidāhaṃ, bhante, samayaṃ yena pakudho kaccāyano tenupasaṅkamiṃ;
content: 「大德！有這一次，我去見浮陀迦旃延。

original: upasaṅkamitvā pakudhena kaccāyanena saddhiṃ sammodiṃ.
content: 抵達後與浮陀迦旃延一起互相問候。

original: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃ.
content: 交換應該被互相問候的友好交談後，在一旁坐下。

original: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho ahaṃ, bhante, pakudhaṃ kaccāyanaṃ etadavocaṃ–
content: 在一旁坐下的我對浮陀迦旃延說這個：

original: ‘ yathā nu kho imāni, bho kaccāyana, puthusippāyatanāni… pe… sakkā nu kho, bho kaccāyana, evameva diṭṭheva dhamme sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ paññapetun’ ti?
content: 『迦旃延尊師！如這些個個技能處……（中略）同樣的，迦旃延尊師！你能夠告知在當生中直接可見的沙門果？』(173)

original: 174.‘‘ Evaṃ vutte, bhante, pakudho kaccāyano maṃ etadavoca–
content: 大德！在這麼說時，浮陀迦旃延對我說這個：

original: ‘ sattime, mahārāja, kāyā akaṭā akaṭavidhā animmitā animmātā vañjhā kūṭaṭṭhā esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhitā.
content: 『大王！有這七身，是非被作的、非被作之種類的、非被創造的、無創造者、[[avañjhā#不孕的]]、如山頂站立的、如石柱狀態住立的，

original: Te na iñjanti , na vipariṇamanti, na aññamaññaṃ byābādhenti, nālaṃ aññamaññassa sukhāya vā dukkhāya vā sukhadukkhāya vā.
content: 它們不搖動、不變易、不互相加害、不足以互相[起]或樂或苦或苦樂，

original: Katame satta?
content: 哪七個？

original: Pathavikāyo, āpokāyo, tejokāyo, vāyokāyo, sukhe, dukkhe, jīve sattame – ime satta kāyā akaṭā akaṭavidhā animmitā animmātā vañjhā kūṭaṭṭhā esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhitā.
content: 地身、水身、火身、風身、樂、苦，命為第七，這七身是非被作的、非被作之種類的、非被創造的、無創造者、不孕的、如山頂站立的、如石柱狀態住立的，

original: Te na iñjanti, na vipariṇamanti, na aññamaññaṃ byābādhenti, nālaṃ aññamaññassa sukhāya vā dukkhāya vā sukhadukkhāya vā.
content: 它們不搖動、不變易、不互相加害、不足以互相[起]或樂或苦或苦樂，

original: Tattha natthi hantā vā ghātetā vā, sotā vā sāvetā vā, viññātā vā viññāpetā vā.
content: 在那裡，無殺人者、屠殺者、聽者、使之聽者、所識者、使之識者，

original: Yopi tiṇhena satthena sīsaṃ chindati, na koci kiñci[ kañci( kaṃ.)] jīvitā voropeti;
content: 凡即使以銳利的刀切斷頭，他也沒奪取任何生命，

original: sattannaṃ tveva[ sattannaṃ yeva( sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] kāyānamantarena satthaṃ vivaramanupatatī’ ti.
content: 刀但就經七身的中間隨進入。』[SN.24.8, MN.76](174)

original: 175.‘‘ Itthaṃ kho me, bhante, pakudho kaccāyano sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ puṭṭho samāno aññena aññaṃ byākāsi.
content: 大德！像這樣，當浮陀迦旃延被我詢問直接可見的沙門果時，解說無關的(以其他的解說其他的)。

original: Seyyathāpi, bhante, ambaṃ vā puṭṭho labujaṃ byākareyya, labujaṃ vā puṭṭho ambaṃ byākareyya;
content: 大德！猶如被詢問芒果，解答波羅蜜果，或被詢問波羅蜜果，解答芒果。

original: evameva kho me, bhante, pakudho kaccāyano sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ puṭṭho samāno aññena aññaṃ byākāsi.
content: 同樣的，大德！當浮陀迦旃延被我詢問直接可見的沙門果時，解說無關的。

original: Tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, etadahosi–
content: 大德！我想這個：

original: ‘ kathañhi nāma mādiso samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā vijite vasantaṃ apasādetabbaṃ maññeyyā’ ti.
content: 『像我這樣的，怎麼會想住在領土中的沙門或婆羅門應該被貶低？』

original: So kho ahaṃ, bhante, pakudhassa kaccāyanassa bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandiṃ nappaṭikkosiṃ, anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā anattamano, anattamanavācaṃ anicchāretvā tameva vācaṃ anuggaṇhanto anikkujjanto uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṃ.
content: 大德！那個我對浮陀迦旃延的所說既不歡喜，也不斥責。不歡喜、不斥責後，不悅意地不發不悅意之語，就對那個言語不拿起地、不傾覆地從座位起來後離開。(175)

original: Nigaṇṭhanāṭaputtavādo
content: 尼乾陀若提子之論

original: 176.‘‘ Ekamidāhaṃ, bhante, samayaṃ yena nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto tenupasaṅkamiṃ ;
content: 「大德！有這一次，我去見尼乾陀若提子。

original: upasaṅkamitvā nigaṇṭhena nāṭaputtena saddhiṃ sammodiṃ.
content: 抵達後與尼乾陀若提子一起互相問候。

original: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃ.
content: 交換應該被互相問候的友好交談後，在一旁坐下。

original: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho ahaṃ, bhante, nigaṇṭhaṃ nāṭaputtaṃ etadavocaṃ–
content: 在一旁坐下的我對尼乾陀若提子說這個：

original: ‘ yathā nu kho imāni, bho aggivessana, puthusippāyatanāni… pe… sakkā nu kho, bho aggivessana, evameva diṭṭheva dhamme sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ paññapetun’ ti?
content: 『阿其威色那尊師！如這些個個技能處……（中略）同樣的，阿其威色那尊師！你能夠告知在當生中直接可見的沙門果？』(176)

original: 177.‘‘ Evaṃ vutte, bhante, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto maṃ etadavoca–
content: 大德！在這麼說時，尼乾陀若提子對我說這個：

original: ‘ idha, mahārāja, nigaṇṭho cātuyāmasaṃvarasaṃvuto hoti.
content: 『大王！這裡，尼乾陀被四種禁戒的[[saṃvaraṃ#自制]]自制，

original: Kathañca, mahārāja, nigaṇṭho cātuyāmasaṃvarasaṃvuto hoti?
content: 大王！尼乾陀如何被四種禁戒的自制自制？

original: Idha, mahārāja, nigaṇṭho sabbavārivārito ca hoti, sabbavāriyutto ca, sabbavāridhuto ca, sabbavāriphuṭo ca.
content: 大王！這裡，尼乾陀有{{note|trigger=被所有防止防止|text=「被所有防止防止」(sabbavārivārito)，Maurice Walshe先生英譯為「被所有抑制抑制」(curbed by all curbs, DN.2)，菩提比丘長老英譯為「被所有抑制抑制」(curbed by all curbs, MN.56)，並解說，「vāri」是個雙關語，一個意思是「水」，另一個意思是「防止」(從vāreti，動詞)。按：《破斥猶豫》等解說為，一切水被防止(vāritasabbaudako)，一切冷水被拒絕(paṭikkhittasabbasītodakoti)之意，因為他對冷水為眾生想者(sattasaññī)，因此不使用(vaḷañjeti)它，並對往後的三句均以「惡的防止」(pāpavāraṇena, MN.56/DN.2)解說，今依此譯。}}，被所有防止軛制，被所有防止除去，{{note|trigger=被所有防止遍滿|text=「被所有防止遍滿」(sabbavāriphuṭo, sabbavāriphuṭṭho)，菩提比丘長老英譯為「被所有抑制要求」(claimed by all curbs, MN.56)，Maurice Walshe先生英譯亦同(DN.2)。按：《破斥猶豫》以「被所有惡的防止遍滿」(sabbena pāpavāraṇena phuṭo, MN.56)解說，《吉祥悅意》以「被所有惡的防止接觸」(sabbena pāpavāraṇena phuṭṭho, DN.2)解說，今依前者譯。}}[MN.56]，

original: Evaṃ kho, mahārāja, nigaṇṭho cātuyāmasaṃvarasaṃvuto hoti .
content: 大王！尼乾陀這麼被四種禁戒的自制自制。

original: Yato kho, mahārāja, nigaṇṭho evaṃ cātuyāmasaṃvarasaṃvuto hoti;
content: 大王！當尼乾陀這麼被四種禁戒的自制自制，

original: ayaṃ vuccati, mahārāja, nigaṇṭho[ nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto( syā. ka.)] gatatto ca yatatto ca ṭhitatto cā’ ti.
content: 大王！這被稱為已自我達成、已自我抑制、已自我住立的尼乾陀。』(177)

original: 178.‘‘ Itthaṃ kho me, bhante, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ puṭṭho samāno cātuyāmasaṃvaraṃ byākāsi.
content: 大德！像這樣，當尼乾陀若提子被我詢問直接可見的沙門果時，解說四種禁戒的自制。

original: Seyyathāpi, bhante, ambaṃ vā puṭṭho labujaṃ byākareyya, labujaṃ vā puṭṭho ambaṃ byākareyya;
content: 大德！猶如被詢問芒果，解答波羅蜜果，或被詢問波羅蜜果，解答芒果。

original: evameva kho me, bhante, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ puṭṭho samāno cātuyāmasaṃvaraṃ byākāsi.
content: 同樣的，大德！當尼乾陀若提子被我詢問直接可見的沙門果時，解說四種禁戒的自制。

original: Tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, etadahosi–
content: 大德！我想這個：

original: ‘ kathañhi nāma mādiso samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā vijite vasantaṃ apasādetabbaṃ maññeyyā’ ti .
content: 『像我這樣的，怎麼會想住在領土中的沙門或婆羅門應該被貶低？』

original: So kho ahaṃ, bhante, nigaṇṭhassa nāṭaputtassa bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandiṃ nappaṭikkosiṃ.
content: 大德！那個我對尼乾陀若提子的所說既不歡喜，也不斥責。

original: Anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā anattamano anattamanavācaṃ anicchāretvā tameva vācaṃ anuggaṇhanto anikkujjanto uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṃ.
content: 不歡喜、不斥責後，不悅意地不發不悅意之語，就對那個言語不拿起地、不傾覆地從座位起來後離開。(178)

original: Sañcayabelaṭṭhaputtavādo
content: 散惹耶毘羅梨子之論

original: 179.‘‘ Ekamidāhaṃ, bhante, samayaṃ yena sañcayo belaṭṭhaputto tenupasaṅkamiṃ;
content: 「大德！有這一次，我去見散惹耶毘羅梨子。

original: upasaṅkamitvā sañcayena belaṭṭhaputtena saddhiṃ sammodiṃ.
content: 抵達後與散惹耶毘羅梨子一起互相問候。

original: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃ.
content: 交換應該被互相問候的友好交談後，在一旁坐下。

original: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho ahaṃ bhante, sañcayaṃ belaṭṭhaputtaṃ etadavocaṃ–
content: 在一旁坐下的我對散惹耶毘羅梨子說這個：

original: ‘ yathā nu kho imāni, bho sañcaya, puthusippāyatanāni… pe… sakkā nu kho, bho sañcaya, evameva diṭṭheva dhamme sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ paññapetun’ ti?
content: 『散惹耶毘羅梨子尊師！如這些個個技能處……（中略）同樣的，散惹耶尊師！你能夠告知在當生中直接可見的沙門果？』(179)

original: 180.‘‘ Evaṃ vutte, bhante, sañcayo belaṭṭhaputto maṃ etadavoca–
content: 大德！在這麼說時，散惹耶毘羅梨子對我說這個：

original: ‘ atthi paro lokoti iti ce maṃ pucchasi, atthi paro lokoti iti ce me assa, atthi paro lokoti iti te naṃ byākareyyaṃ.
content: 『像這樣如果詢問我：「有其他世間？」像這樣如果我想：「有其他世間。」像這樣我應該回答你：「有其他世間。」

original: Evantipi me no, tathātipi me no, aññathātipi me no, notipi me no, no notipi me no.
content: 「這樣」不被我[回答]；「那樣」也不被我；「另一種」也不被我；「不」也不被我；「非不」也不被我。

original: Natthi paro loko… pe… atthi ca natthi ca paro loko… pe… nevatthi na natthi paro loko… pe… atthi sattā opapātikā… pe… natthi sattā opapātikā… pe… atthi ca natthi ca sattā opapātikā… pe… nevatthi na natthi sattā opapātikā… pe… atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko… pe… natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko… pe… atthi ca natthi ca sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko… pe… nevatthi na natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko… pe… hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā… pe… na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā… pe… hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā… pe… neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti iti ce maṃ pucchasi, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti iti ce me assa, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti iti te naṃ byākareyyaṃ.
content: 沒有其他世間……（中略）有且沒有其他世間……（中略）既非有也非沒有其他世間……（中略）有化生眾生……（中略）沒有化生眾生……（中略）有且沒有化生眾生……（中略）既非有也非沒有化生眾生……（中略）有善作的、惡作的業之果與報……（中略）沒有善作的、惡作的業之果與報……（中略）有且沒有善作的、惡作的業之果與報……（中略）既非有也非沒有善作的、惡作的業之果與報……（中略）死後如來存在……（中略）死後如來不存在……（中略）[[hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā#死後如來存在且不存在]]……（中略）像這樣如果詢問我：「死後如來既非存在也非不存在嗎？」像這樣如果我想：「死後如來既非存在也非不存在。」像這樣我應該回答你：「死後如來既非存在也非不存在。」但我不說：「是這樣。」

original: Evantipi me no, tathātipi me no, aññathātipi me no, notipi me no, no notipi me no’ ti.
content: 「這樣」不被我[回答]；「那樣」也不被我；「另一種」也不被我；「不」也不被我；「非不」也不被我。』(180)

original: 181.‘‘ Itthaṃ kho me, bhante, sañcayo belaṭṭhaputto sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ puṭṭho samāno vikkhepaṃ byākāsi.
content: 大德！像這樣，當散惹耶毘羅梨子被我詢問直接可見的沙門果時，解說{{note|trigger=混亂|text=「混亂」(vikkhepaṃ，另譯為「散亂」，名詞)，Maurice Walshe先生英譯為「逃避」(evasion)。按：《吉祥悅意》以「詭辯」(amarāvikkhepe，逐字譯為「鰻魚+混亂」，另譯為「不死憍亂論」)解說。}}。

original: Seyyathāpi, bhante, ambaṃ vā puṭṭho labujaṃ byākareyya, labujaṃ vā puṭṭho ambaṃ byākareyya;
content: 大德！猶如被詢問芒果，解答波羅蜜果，或被詢問波羅蜜果，解答芒果。

original: evameva kho me, bhante, sañcayo belaṭṭhaputto sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ puṭṭho samāno vikkhepaṃ byākāsi.
content: 同樣的，大德！當散惹耶毘羅梨子被我詢問直接可見的沙門果時，解說混亂。

original: Tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, etadahosi–
content: 大德！我想這個：

original: ‘ ayañca imesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ sabbabālo sabbamūḷho.
content: 『而這位是這些沙門婆羅門中最愚癡的、最愚昧的，

original: Kathañhi nāma sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ puṭṭho samāno vikkhepaṃ byākarissatī’ ti.
content: 當他被我詢問直接可見的沙門果時，怎麼會解說混亂呢？』

original: Tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, etadahosi–
content: 大德！我想這個：

original: ‘ kathañhi nāma mādiso samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā vijite vasantaṃ apasādetabbaṃ maññeyyā’ ti.
content: 『像我這樣的，怎麼會想住在領土中的沙門或婆羅門應該被貶低？』

original: So kho ahaṃ, bhante, sañcayassa belaṭṭhaputtassa bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandiṃ nappaṭikkosiṃ.
content: 大德！那個我對散惹耶毘羅梨子的所說既不歡喜，也不斥責。

original: Anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā anattamano anattamanavācaṃ anicchāretvā tameva vācaṃ anuggaṇhanto anikkujjanto uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṃ.
content: 不歡喜、不斥責後，不悅意地不發不悅意之語，就對那個言語不拿起地、不傾覆地從座位起來後離開。(181)
